evidence.detail: prepare() loops over self.people; for each user without a Redis cache entry it issues two separate SQL queries (a .count() call at line 39 and a text() query at lines 40-48), producing N×2 DB hits per page for cold or expired cache
Pagination was added (paginate() call), which reduces N per request, but does not eliminate the per-user query pattern

triage.fix_sketch: In logsite/views/people.py, replace the per-person loop in prepare() with two bulk queries: (1) a single COUNT(*) GROUP BY user_id query for recent match counts across all user IDs on the page, and (2) a single SELECT f.name, COUNT(*) … GROUP BY mp.user_id, f.id query for favourite formats. Then populate Redis per-user from those bulk results. Changes confined to prepare() in logsite/views/people.py, ~35-50 lines.
triage.notes: The author noted the deeper fix would be to reactify logsite, but the bulk-query approach is isolated and safe. Existing smoke_test.py covers the /people/ route.
